input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand. Failure to send the reminder extends Customer's opt-out deadline until thirty days after the reminder is received.
input.rationale: Renewal terms sit at the preferred position. § 8.2 provides automatic twelve-month (not multi-year) renewals that Customer alone may exit on thirty days' written notice — within the preferred ≤30-day window — plus a Vendor reminder sixty days before renewal, with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed (a customer-favourable addition). § 8.3 caps renewal uplifts at the lesser of CPI and three percent, matching the preferred cap, requires ninety days' notice of any increase, and exempts prepaid periods. § 8.1's fixed three-year initial term is a negotiated initial commitment, not an automatic multi-year renewal, so it does not engage the walk-away trigger. No redline needed.
